english.note: Use this when the tabloid style mainly relies on emotional or sensational presentation.
Pick this when the presentation deliberately tries to stir emotions or sensationalize shocking or sexual material.
Use this for language or headlines that are excessively emotional or hysterical rather than simply exciting.
Use this for reporting or content that is lurid, emotionally manipulative, or sensationalist.
